title: A Phase 2, Dose Finding Study of PF-03187207 in Patients With Primary Open Angle Glaucoma or Ocular Hypertension.
brief_summary: To investigate dose response, safety and efficacy of PF-03187207 in patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Man or woman at least 20 years of age
* Diagnosis of primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension in one or both eyes.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Closed/barely open anterior chamber angle or a history of acute angle closure in either eye
* Contraindications to latanoprost and nitric oxide treatment
* Known latanoprost non-responders
